versionName: Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars

activities.name: Grab Your Opening Gifts
activities.description: Let the show begin! Aha brought a ton of great gifts! "Affinitive Starveil" lets you pick one Affinitive Eidolon for Acheron, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, or Jing Yuan; "Magic Invitation" grants one of those characters plus upgrade materials to instantly reach Lv. 60; "Stellar Companions" grants Golden Companion Spirit ×1; "Aha Reckons You Need This" offers Star Rail Special Pass ×20 through cumulative check-in; plus the outfit "Yellow-Purple Style," headwear "Elation Proxy," and the custom Relic item "Asat Pramad's Gift." Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 4.

activities.name: The Fluffy Movie: Overheated
activities.description: Leave Fluffy Across the Blue unfinished? Sorry, but the greatest and most responsible comic artist, Blurry_QR_Colt, could never do such a thing. In fact, she's even going to draw a gourmet story version! She has left behind an inheritance waiting to be claimed. To get your hands on it, you'll have to first finish this masterpiece. However, "drawing" comics isn't as simple as you think... Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 21.

activities.name: Interastral Peace Gala: Road to Fame
activities.description: Want to become the star of the show? Step onto the stage, take down your rivals, and win cheers and applause with your brilliance! Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 21.

activities.name: Relic Recon
activities.description: A mysterious collection vault in the Herta Space Station has opened its doors to you, filled with countless chests containing wondrous items. If you could get your hands on a special access card... Requirement: Trailblaze Level ≥ 21.

activities.name: Anomaly Arbitration: Hidden Stage
activities.description: High-difficulty challenge gameplay updated with the version, rewarding Lone Stardust, Interference Keys, Self-Modeling Resin, and limited-time avatar frames.

activities.name: Apocalyptic Shadow: Dominance of Oblivion
activities.description: When an enemy target with "Steadfast Safeguard" is Weakness Broken, dispel control debuffs for all ally targets, advance their actions, and make Aha immediately gain an extra turn (this turn counts as a fixed 10 Punchline). Increases Ultimate DMG taken by all enemy targets by 25% and Elation DMG by 15%.

activities.name: Apocalyptic Shadow: Navigator's Netherveil
activities.description: When an enemy target with "Steadfast Safeguard" is Weakness Broken, dispel control debuffs for all ally targets and activate their Ultimates. Increases Skill DMG taken by all enemy targets by 25% and increases Elation DMG by 15%.

activities.name: Pure Fiction: Imagined Words
activities.description: When an ally target applies a debuff to an enemy target, allies additionally accumulate 1 Grit Value. This effect can trigger up to 10 times per enemy target.

activities.name: Pure Fiction: Fiction Made Truth
activities.description: Each time Punchline is gained, allies will additionally accumulate 2 Grit Value.

activities.name: Memory of Chaos: Survival of the Fittest
activities.description: Allies gain 5 Punchline when using their Ultimate. At the start of each Cycle, make Aha immediately gain an extra turn that counts as a fixed 20 Punchline and does not consume Punchline.

activities.name: Memory of Chaos: Echo of Darkness
activities.description: Increases Basic ATK DMG dealt by all ally targets by 50%. After an ally character uses their Basic ATK, adds 1 Hit Per Action to "Memory Turbulence," up to a maximum of 15 hits. At the start of each Cycle, "Memory Turbulence" deals 1 instance of True DMG to a random enemy target with each Hit Per Action.
